name: 385 Grill & Campground
note: Campground and grill on US-385 south of Deadwood (21372 US-385) in the pines: 30-amp water/electric sites $39-44, 30-amp full hookups $52, 50-amp full hookups $60-61 (some creek-view), dry sites $27, cabins. --Claude
inclusion_evidence: 385grillcamp.com/camping read 2026-10-03: 30 AMP water RV site $41, parallel 30 AMP water $39, 30 amp FHU $52, 50 amp FHU $60-61, dry $27. Not on RV Life; Good Sam directory row -> published rate <= $50 passes ($39-41 water/electric); Google 4.6 over 45 with phone. Open beyond the rally, not an event-only campground

name: Eagles Landing Campground
note: Year-round campground on Avalanche Rd just north of Sturgis (2881 Avalanche Rd): back-in gravel RV sites around $40 a night, tent sites, cabins with baths; a Sturgis Rally base that is open all year. Online booking (ResNexus). --Claude
inclusion_evidence: campsturgis.com read 2026-10-03 ('Year-Round Camping In Sturgis SD', RV back-in gravel sites); ResNexus booking returned a $40.00/night standard rate for RV sites (cabins $70-110). Not on RV Life; Good Sam directory row (Good Sam overall 5.3) -> quality from Google 4.4 over 88 with phone; published rate <= $50 passes. Year-round, so not an event-only rally campground
